evidence.excerpt:
Participants as supplied: Maria Romero <maria@example.test>
Hi!

Want to host this year? We can do the turkey if you take the sides. Kids are flying in Wednesday night, so Thursday at 2 works best.

Let me know by Friday so I can order the bird.

Maria

Namaste,
Sunrise Yoga Studio

P.
